items.title: Inheritance – Reusing and Extending Functionality (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Inheritance aik class ko doosri class ki properties aur methods lene deti hai. Nayi class, jise subclass kehte hain, parent class ki khusoosiyat mein izafa ya tabdeeli kar sakti hai. Inheritance code ke dobara istemal (reuse) ko barhati aur aik hi code ki takrar (redundancy) kam karti hai. Is se maujooda code dobara likhe baghair program ko barhana aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Inheritance ko virasat samjhein: jaise bachche ko walidain ki cheezein mil jati hain, waise hi child class ko parent class ke attributes aur methods mil jate hain, aur woh apni nayi cheezein bhi jor sakti hai. Agle teen lessons teen qismein batate hain: single, multiple aur multilevel.
